_comment: Example den-host configuration. Copy to den-host.json and adjust for your environment. Do not commit secrets; use DEN_HOST_CORE_API_KEY / DEN_HOST_CHANNELS_API_KEY env vars instead.

Adapter._comment_ManagedRoles: Host-level roles this adapter instance claims it can satisfy. The Hermes module also advertises its own roles under Harness:Modules[].Settings.roles; both are honored by the Channels event matcher (host-level match is a structural signal, module-level match means 'this harness can actually serve the role'). Leave empty if you want the Hermes module's roles to be the only source of truth.

Core._comment_ApiKey: Set DEN_HOST_CORE_API_KEY env var instead of filling this in.

Channels._comment_paths: EventsListPath is the transitional gateway list endpoint; DirectAgentEventPath is the primary Channels readback (GET /api/direct-agent-events/{eventId}). Set EventsListChannelId or EventsListProjectId so the list reader has a scope.
Channels._comment_ApiKey: Set DEN_HOST_CHANNELS_API_KEY env var instead of filling this in.

Settings._comment: Hermes module is the first concrete harness. Set binary_path / profile / home for your install. 'roles' is a CSV of Den-facing role names this module satisfies.
